newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia to adopt export financing programme-agency.
newsitem.headline: Serbia to adopt export financing programme-agency.

text.p: The Serbian government is expected on Wednesday to adopt a financing programme aimed at doubling exports this year, state news agency Tanjug reported.
Exports will be financed through the Serbian Development Fund and interested companies should submit their projects and proposals to the government and the Fund by the end of the week, Tanjug said.
The Fund is the recepient of nearly $1 billion which Serbia raised through the sale of a 49 percent stake in telecommunications company Telekom Srbija on Monday.
The government aims to increase efficiency and speed up financing of exports, a senior official Dragan Tomic was quoted as saying. -- Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
